stages.description: Miriam sets clinical context, states learning objectives, and anchors patient-safety expectations.
stages.system_note: System listens only; does not generate content.

stages.description: System generates draft content items for the module.
stages.system_note: Items are flagged draft; none delivered to learners until guide-review stage completes.

stages.description: Miriam reviews each item. She may replace, remove, or flag items. Every change is an override record. System re-checks schema only; does not edit content.
stages.system_note: System must yield to every guide override. System may only flag schema errors, never content disagreement.

stages.description: System sequences the reviewed module for each learner, presenting items and collecting responses.
stages.system_note: Only post-review items are delivered. System cannot reintroduce removed or replaced items.

stages.description: Miriam receives aggregate learner performance, reviews safety-flag summary, and decides whether any item needs a follow-up correction.
stages.system_note: System presents data; Miriam decides all actions.

system_can: generate draft content items for guide review
flag items it rates low-confidence for guide attention
system_cannot: deliver any item to learners before content-review stage completes
silently edit or omit any content item
remove an override record once written
override the guide's clinical judgement with its own
